title: Getting started with IonFamilies
text: One compound LC-MS experiment gives many features: protonated deprotonated molecule, adducts [M+Na]+, -source fragments [M+H-H2O]+, isotopes . Together form compound’s ion family. Recognising ion families reduces redundancy helps work neutral mass unknown compounds. groupFeatures() MsFeatures xcms packages groups features probably come compound (similar retention time, correlated abundances across samples, similar peak shapes). deliberately stops . IonFamilies takes groups annotates, within group, isotope patterns, MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues(), checks mass differences intensity ratios, adducts fragments, neutral-mass voting rule list: neutral mass suggested two features group can explained different ions . supported neutral-mass hypotheses kept ranked. annotations meant hints check, default rule list long recall preferred precision. Results written featureDefinitions() XcmsExperiment: isotopes adduct columns use CAMERA’s text syntax, grouping feature_group column written groupFeatures(). vignette neutral-mass voting works explains method step step. CAMERA grouping, isotope adduct annotation, works legacy xcmsSet class. IonFamilies re-implements neutral-mass voting groupFeatures() groups keeps hypotheses, ranked, instead one per feature. InterpretMSSpectrum (findMAIN()) ranks main-adduct hypotheses single spectrum. RAMClustR uses clustering. cliqueMS annotates one sample time grouping. MetaboAnnotation matches features compound databases. complements database-free annotation .

title: Isotope and Adduct Annotation of LC-MS Feature Groups
text: Isotope adduct annotation LC-MS feature groups. One compound gives many LC-MS features: quasi-molecular ion, adducts, -source fragments isotopes , ion family. groupFeatures() MsFeatures xcms groups features come compound. IonFamilies annotates ion family within group: annotateIsotopes() finds isotope patterns MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues(). annotateAdducts() finds adducts fragments neutral-mass voting rule list (default commonMZ). supported hypotheses kept ranked, annotations hints missed true annotation worse coincidental one. Results go featureDefinitions() XcmsExperiment: isotopes adduct hold labels text CAMERA’s syntax, grouping feature_group column groupFeatures(). hypotheses kept list column adduct_hints (adductHints()), parameters metadata(x)$IonFamilies.
code: library(xcms) library(MsFeatures) library(IonFamilies)  x <- groupFeatures(x, SimilarRtimeParam(diffRt = 3)) x <- groupFeatures(x, AbundanceSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, transform = log2)) x <- annotateIsotopes(x, IsotopologueParam(ppm = 10)) x <- annotateAdducts(x, AdductVoteParam(polarity = "positive", nBest = 3)) featureDefinitions(x)[, c("feature_group", "isotopes", "adduct")] adductHints(x)

what: IonFamilies: isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups — IonFamilies-package
title: IonFamilies: isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups — IonFamilies-package
text: One compound gives several LC-MS features: quasi-molecular ion, adducts, -source fragments, isotopes . package annotates ion family within groups features, typically groups made MsFeatures::groupFeatures() xcms::XcmsExperiment.

title: IonFamilies: isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups — IonFamilies-package
text: workflow two steps: annotateIsotopes() IsotopologueParam() finds isotope patterns MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues() labels CAMERA syntax ([3][M]+, [3][M+1]+). annotateAdducts() AdductVoteParam() finds adducts fragments neutral-mass voting rule list (defaultAdductRules()). supported hypotheses kept ranked (adductHints()); best nBest written text (formatAdducts()). Annotations hints: suggest check, identify compound.
